name: systemd-service
description: Practice-box helper: installs a systemd unit and (by default) enables and starts it -- a real, ps-visible process. Reusable for both plainly-malicious services and plausible-looking ones. Vars: SERVICE_NAME (required, no .service suffix); EXEC_START (required); DESCRIPTION (optional); SERVICE_TYPE (optional, default simple); EXTRA_LINE (optional extra [Service] line, e.g. a hidden Environment=/flag only visible via `systemctl cat`); PAYLOAD_PATH + PAYLOAD_BODY (optional: write a payload script the unit runs); ENABLE (optional, default 1 -- set 0 to install without enabling).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

: "${SERVICE_NAME:?SERVICE_NAME is required}"
: "${EXEC_START:?EXEC_START is required}"

if [ -n "${PAYLOAD_PATH-}" ]; then
    install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
    printf '%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
fi

unit="/etc/systemd/system/${SERVICE_NAME}.service"
{
    printf '%s\n' '[Unit]'
    printf 'Description=%s\n' "${DESCRIPTION:-System service}"
    printf '%s\n\n' 'After=network.target'
    printf '%s\n' '[Service]'
    printf 'Type=%s\n' "${SERVICE_TYPE:-simple}"
    printf 'ExecStart=%s\n' "$EXEC_START"
    if [ -n "${EXTRA_LINE-}" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$EXTRA_LINE"; fi
    printf '%s\n\n' 'Restart=always'
    printf '%s\n' '[Install]'
    printf '%s\n' 'WantedBy=multi-user.target'
} > "$unit"
chmod 0644 "$unit"

if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    systemctl daemon-reload
    if [ "${ENABLE:-1}" = "1" ]; then
        systemctl enable --now "${SERVICE_NAME}.service"
    fi
fi
